rows.description: Attack with your weapon for 22–37 physical damage.
A spell that damages for 2-22 damage.
A spell that heals for 6-11 healing.
A crude strike spell that damages a single enemy for 6-10 damage. And has a 10% chance to reduce the enemy's agility by 1.
Damage covered enemies for 29-31 damage, with a 25% chance to increase their damage taken by 10%.
A spell that damages for 10-16 damage.
A vital strike spell that damages a single enemy for 35.8-41.8 damage. And heals the caster for 50% of the damage dealt.
A splinter shot spell that damages a single enemy for 6-10 damage. And has a 20% chance to reduce the enemy's armor by 10%.
Damages a single enemy for 14-20 magical damage. 30% chance to apply a burn for 2 turns.
A spell that damages for 12-15 damage.
A soulflare spell that damages a single enemy for 37-42 magical damage. Heals the caster for 50% of the damage dealt.
Damage covered enemies for 23-28 magical damage, with a 25% chance to increase their damage taken by 10%.
A crushing blow spell that damages a single enemy for 25.2-29.2 damage. And has a 30% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn.
Increase your armor by 25% for 2 turns.
Damage covered enemies for 16-22 magical damage, with a 40% chance to stun them for 1 turn. Stun prevents acting and moving.
A verdant smite spell that damages a single enemy for 30-38 magical damage. 50% chance to reduce target's defense by 15% for 2 turns.
A nature's embrace spell that heals all allies for 27-37 healing.
A surge of lightning that damages all enemies for 27-34 magical damage. Has a 25% chance to paralyze targets for 1 turn.
A powerful strike that damages a single enemy for 46.4-52.4 damage. Has a 30% chance to stun the target for 1 turn.
A staggering jab that damages a single enemy for 4-6 damage. And has a 20% chance to paralyze the enemy for 1 turn.
A magical roar that has a 60% chance to stun a single enemy for 1 turn.
A spiraling torrent that damages enemies in the eight surrounding tiles for 53-59 physical damage. Has a 25% chance to apply vulnerability for 2 turns.
Damage each enemy in the line for 71.6-76.6 damage. Each target has a 30% chance for the attack to ignore 25% of its defense.
A magical blessing that heals an ally for 19-20.25 healing.
A wave of water that damages covered enemies for 10-14 magical damage. Has a 20% chance to reduce Agility by 2 for 1 turn. Movement is unchanged.
A magical pulse that damages covered enemies for 18-24 magical damage. Has a 25% chance to reduce Agility by 2 for 1 turn. Movement is unchanged.
A spell that heals the caster for 20-26 healing.
A rupturing attack that damages a single enemy for 8-12 physical damage. Has a 20% chance to cause bleeding (4 damage per turn for 2 turns).
A storm pulse that damages up to 3 distinct random enemies for 13-28 physical damage.
Strike a random living enemy up to 4 times for 20-24 magical damage per strike. The same enemy may be hit repeatedly. Each strike has a 30% chance to stun the target.
Deal 86.8-92.8 physical damage. Against a target at or below 10% health, replace Strength scaling with its maximum health before defenses and other damage effects.

"The shield does not guard one – it guards all." Grants all allies a Protective Shield equal to 37.5% of your Max HP for 2 rounds. While shields are active, you gain +20 Armor and +20 Magic Resistance.
"When steel and will collide, even mountains tremble." A powerful strike that damages a single enemy for 52-57 damage and stuns the target for 1 turn.

Damage all enemies for 58-65 damage. One cast-level roll has a 50% chance to attempt a 1-turn stun on each enemy. If at least 2 stuns apply, gain +20 Armor and Magic Resistance until the end of battle.
Protect one ally, including yourself, for 1 round: reduce incoming damage by 50% and reflect 67.5% back to the attacker. Does not stack with Thorn Carapace (chooses the stronger effect).
A bladestorm rhythm spell that damages a single enemy for 42-48 damage twice.
Unyielding spirit, unbroken flesh. Cleanses all debuffs and grants +20 Magic Resistance & +20 Armor for 2 rounds. If HP is below 30%, also restores 10% Max HP on cast.
Channel for 2 turns, unable to act or move. Then deal 160% Intelligence damage to surviving original enemy targets still on the opposing team. Movement cannot dodge the discharge.
"Some see only one motion – but the blade has already fallen twice." Grants the player a second action in the next round.
